evidence: tools/green_check.py:288-296 picks `record.green`/`record.exact_green` as the newest run by stamp across both archived and local manifests (`if record.green is None or run.stamp >= record.green.stamp: record.green = run`). :334 `"certified_archived": bool(record.green and record.green.archived)`. tools/ledger.py:4048 derived_status returns certified only if `green_check.green_at_these_bytes(records.get(book))`, which requires certified_archived. Its output is written into planning/proofs.json, and `ledger.py --check` compares that file byte-for-byte (ledger.py:4195-4203).
fix: Choose the green that decides the archived/certified question among archived runs only. Report a newer local run separately (for example "also green locally at <run>"), so committed generated output is a function of committed inputs.
reviewer: manifests() (green_check.py:145-178) merges archived manifests with local build/acl2 ones (archived=False). The selection at :288-296 takes the newest by stamp regardless of archived, and certified_archived (:334) reflects only that run. ledger.derived_status (ledger.py:4040-4048) calls green_check.audit and requires green_at_these_bytes, which requires certified_archived. So a newer local green, or a newer local red, downgrades the generated status in that worktree only, and ledger --check then diverges between trees. The effect is only a downgrade, never a false certified, so it is a reproducibility and confusion problem rather than a soundness hole.
scenario: Two worktrees sit at the same commit. Book B has an archived green run at its current bytes and closure. One worktree also holds a newer, unfiled local run under build/acl2/certify-*/manifest.json that also certified B. In that tree record.green is the local run, so certified_archived is False and every proofs.json row citing B regenerates as "uncertified-at-current-digest". `ledger.py --check` reports proofs.json stale in that tree and clean in the other. A `--write` there commits a downgrade that a committed manifest contradicts. A newer local red has the same effect.
title: A newer local unarchived manifest hides an archived green, so the committed proofs.json status depends on untracked build/acl2 contents
